name: proxy
description: route Claude Code requests through multiple upstream providers (OpenCode Go, OpenCode Zen, and AWS Bedrock) with automatic model selection and format transformation.

capability_evidence.auto-failover: Routing** — Configurable routing for streaming requests (see CONFIGURATION.md)
capability_evidence.model-routing: enCode Go, OpenCode Zen, AWS Bedrock, or OpenRouter from a single config
capability_evidence.provider-aggregation: ng Claude/GPT/Gemini access without multiple API keys
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: ch config file for changes and reload automatically

friction.note_en: Easy. install via Homebrew install; configure environment variables, config file; GUI application
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 Homebrew install 安装；需配置 environment variables、config file；GUI application

analysis.summary_en: route Claude Code requests through multiple upstream providers (OpenCode Go, OpenCode Zen, and AWS Bedrock) with automatic model selection and format transformation.
analysis.install_hint: brew tap routatic/tap && brew install routatic-proxy
highlights: Multi-Provider — Route through OpenCode Go, OpenCode Zen, AWS Bedrock, or OpenRouter from a single config
Anthropic-First Failover — Keep Claude on Anthropic and use OpenCode only during rate limits or outages
Transparent Proxy — Claude Code sends Anthropic-format requests, proxy transforms to provider-native format and back
Version format: v{UPCOMING}-beta.{N} (e.g., v0.6.4-beta.1), where {N} is a sequential counter that restarts once that version ships as stable
